assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Edit Image 1 locally. Keep its existing three-quarter camera angle, gaze direction, framing, head and neck posture, lighting and recognizable man. Make TWO carefully limited corrections: reduce the displeased expression, and repair the chin's awkward block-like three-quarter rendering.

Reference roles: Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 is the approved front view of the SAME man, supplying his restrained neutral expression, identity and refined chin. Image 3 is the same man's profile, a geometry cross-check ONLY for chin projection and the lower-lip-to-chin curve. Do not copy either reference's pose or lighting.

1. EXPRESSION: gently release the inward pinching between the eyebrows and the tension around the mouth. Return the brow to Image 2's natural resting shape as seen from this three-quarter angle. Preserve the existing eyelid opening, pupil positions, horizontal gaze and attention. Let the lips remain softly closed with neutral corners, natural fullness and no compression. He continues watching without revealing his judgment. Do not raise questioning brows, widen the eyes, turn the gaze upward, smile, part the lips, look sleepy, or soften his entire face.

2. CHIN: make the lower lip, natural shallow hollow beneath it, chin front and lower jaw connect as one anatomically coherent form. Image 1 currently gives the chin a conspicuous rounded/block-like pad with an abrupt front plane. Subtly reduce that isolated pad and its ledge-like shading. Use the front and profile references to restore a continuous, gently angular chin, with correct foreshortening of the far side. Retain a modest natural labiomental hollow; no central dimple or cleft. Preserve the approved overall jaw width, lower-face height and chin projection. Do not retract the whole chin, change the bite, protrude the lips, narrow the whole face, produce a pointed V-shaped chin or round babyish jaw. Keep bone definition while making the local transition natural.

Preserve every other feature of Image 1: nose, cheeks, short dark wavy hair, youthful ADULT age, gray-dominant pale blue-gray irises with darker natural rim, skin tone and texture, jacket, black shirt, chair edge and background. Keep existing side light and global contrast, adjusting only local shading that follows the repaired chin form. One photorealistic color photograph, same vertical 3:4 composition, no text or collage.

Edit ONLY the frowning brow region of this image. Preserve the current chin correction, lips, eyelids, eye direction, face shape, three-quarter angle and all other contents.

Make the relaxation visibly readable: release the small vertical tension creases between the eyebrows and slightly ease the inward/downward pull of their medial ends into a natural resting shape. Keep the mouth softly closed exactly as shown. No smile, softened cheeks, sleepy eyes, surprise or sulking. Preserve the existing refined chin, jaw, nose, adult age, hair, skin tone, head-neck alignment, clothing, background, lighting and composition. This is a local relaxation of the glabella and inner eyebrows, not a new face or new pose. One photorealistic color image, same vertical 3:4 format.
